introduction: My greatest passion is to learn and to solve: understanding how things work, why they exist, and how to build solutions from first principles. My background spans software engineering, machine learning, and data science, with a focus on breaking down complex problems and designing reliable, scalable systems.
skillSummary: With a B.Sc. in Software Engineering and an M.Sc. in Data Science & AI from Chalmers University of Technology, supplemented by research in agentic AI at the University of Tokyo (LISD Lab), I possess a solid foundation in both production software architecture and the mathematical principles of machine learning. My experience spans machine learning engineering in industry—designing recommendation algorithms, generative models, and full-stack systems—as well as teaching object-oriented programming.
